newsitem.title: UK: One killed, two hurt in UK chemical plant blast.
newsitem.headline: One killed, two hurt in UK chemical plant blast.

text.p: One man died and two other workers suffered burns in a huge blast at a chemical plant on an industrial estate north of London on Tuesday, police and hospital officials said.

Ten fire crews raced to the scene after the explosion at the Kemast Chemicals Ltd factory in Bletchley, which showered the surrounding area with debris and sent a huge pall of smoke high into the air.

Residents in surrounding streets were evacuated along with hundreds of workers. Police cordoned off the area around the building amid fears that the intense heat could set off secondary explosions. -- London Newsroom +44-171-542-7950
